mapper.select: select fpb.bp_role_type, hbm.bp_code, hbm.bp_name, hbm.bp_id, fpb.credit_grantor_party from fct_project_bp fpb, hls_bp_master hbm where fpb.bp_id=hbm.bp_id and fpb.project_id=#{projectId}
mapper.update: update fct_project_bp set credit_grantor_party='N' where project_id=#{projectId}
mapper.select: SELECT fpb.bp_id as value, (select bp_name from hls_bp_master where bp_id=fpb.bp_id) as meaning FROM fct_project_bp fpb WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
select BANK_ACCOUNT_ID,BP_ID,PROJECT_BP_ID from fct_project_bp where PROJECT_ID=#{projectId} and BP_ROLE_TYPE='SELLER'

select fpb.bp_role_type, hbm.bp_code, hbm.bp_name, hbm.bp_id, fpb.credit_grantor_party from fct_project_bp fpb, hls_bp_master hbm where fpb.bp_id=hbm.bp_id and FPB.CREDIT_GRANTOR_PARTY='Y' and fpb.project_id=#{projectId}

select ( select hbm.bp_code from hls_bp_master hbm where hbm.bp_id=fpb.bp_id )as bp_code, ( select hbm.bp_name from hls_bp_master hbm where hbm.bp_id=fpb.bp_id )as bp_name, ( select hbt.description from hls_bp_type hbt where hbt.bp_type=fpb.bp_role_type )as prj_role,
fpb.contract_number, fpb.project_bp_id, fpb.project_id, fpb.chance_id, fpb.bp_id, fpb.bp_role_type, fpb.credit_grantor_party, fpb.principal_repayment_party, fpb.interest_repayment_party, fpb.down_repayment_party, fpb.use_fee_repayment_party, fpb.compensation_repayment_party, fpb.repay_guarantee_party, fpb.guarantee_type, fpb.guarantee_amount, fpb.mortgage_guarantee_amount, fpb.mortgage_gua_amt_capital, fpb.mortgage_rate, fpb.mortgage_available_amount, fpb.mortgage_avail_amt_capital, fpb.pledge_amount, fpb.pledge_amount_capital, fpb.pledge_rate, fpb.repay_guarantee_sub_amount, fpb.description, fpb.object_version_number, fpb.bank_account_id, fpb.address_id, fpb.contact_info_id, fpb.COMMUNAL_CURRENCY, fpb.COMMUNAL_OTHER_CURRENCY, fpb.COMMUNAL_VALUE, fpb.MORTGAGE_EVALUATION_DATE, fpb.MORTGAGE_EVALUATION_NAME, fpb.MORTGAGE_EVALUATION_CODE, fpb.COLLATERAL_TYPE, fpb.REGISTRATION_AUTHORITY, fpb.REGISTRATION_DATE, fpb.MORTGAGE_DESC, fpb.COLLATERAL_CODE, hbmba.BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM, hbmba.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME, hbmba.BANK_FULL_NAME as bank_name from fct_project_bp fpb left join hls_bp_master_bank_account hbmba on fpb.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID=hbmba.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID
1=1
and fpb.project_id=#{projectId}
and fpb.bp_role_type=#{bpRoleType}
and fpb.bp_role_type in ('SELLER','BUYER')
AND fpb.bp_name like concat('%',concat(#{bpName},'%'))
AND fpb.bp_code like concat('%',concat(#{bpCode},'%'))
select hbm.bp_code, hbm.bp_name from fct_project_bp fpb join hls_bp_master hbm on hbm.bp_id=fpb.bp_id where (hbm.save_flag='N' or hbm.save_flag is null) and fpb.project_id=#{projectId}
mapper.sql: tab.* FROM( select FC.contract_number, fpb.project_id, fpb.principal_repayment_party, fpb.interest_repayment_party, fpb.down_repayment_party, fpb.use_fee_repayment_party, fpb.compensation_repayment_party, fpb.repay_guarantee_party, fpb.bp_role_type, concat(concat(concat(concat(HBMA.country, ( SELECT t1.DESCRIPTION FROM FND_PROVINCE t1 WHERE t1.province = HBMA.province )), ( SELECT t1.DESCRIPTION FROM FND_CITY t1 WHERE t1.city = HBMA.city )), ( SELECT t1.DESCRIPTION FROM FND_DISTRICT t1 WHERE t1.district = HBMA.district)), HBMA.address) as addressInfo, HBMCI.CONTACT_PERSON AS recipient, HBMCI.CELL_PHONE AS contact_info from fct_project_bp fpb left join hls_bp_master_address HBMA on HBMA.ADDRESS_ID=fpb.ADDRESS_ID left join hls_bp_master_contact_info HBMCI on HBMCI.CONTACT_INFO_ID=fpb.CONTACT_INFO_ID LEFT JOIN FCT_CONTRACT FC ON FC.PROJECT_ID = FPB.PROJECT_ID WHERE FC.DATA_CLASS = 'NORMAL' ORDER BY fpb.CREATION_DATE ASC )tab where tab.bp_role_type in ('SELLER','BUYER') -- and tab.repay_guarantee_party= 'N' and tab.contract_number = #{contractNumber}
mapper.select:
SELECT CON.* FROM ( SELECT FC.contract_id, fpb.project_id, FC.DOCUMENT_CATEGORY, concat(concat(concat(concat(HBMA.country, ( SELECT t1.DESCRIPTION FROM FND_PROVINCE t1 WHERE t1.province = HBMA.province )), ( SELECT t1.DESCRIPTION FROM FND_CITY t1 WHERE t1.city = HBMA.city )), ( SELECT t1.DESCRIPTION FROM FND_DISTRICT t1 WHERE t1.district = HBMA.district)), HBMA.address) AS addressInfo, HBMCI.CONTACT_PERSON AS recipient, HBMCI.CELL_PHONE AS contact_info, (case when fpb.principal_repayment_party = 'Y' then '本金支付方 ' else '' end) || (case when fpb.interest_repayment_party = 'Y' then '利息支付方 ' else '' end ) || (case when fpb.repay_guarantee_party = 'Y' then '保证金支付方 'else '' end)|| (case when fpb.use_fee_repayment_party = 'Y' then '咨询服务费支付方 ' else '' end) description FROM fct_project_bp fpb JOIN FCT_CONTRACT FC ON FC.PROJECT_ID = FPB.PROJECT_ID LEFT JOIN hls_bp_master_address HBMA ON HBMA.ADDRESS_ID=fpb.ADDRESS_ID LEFT JOIN hls_bp_master_contact_info HBMCI ON HBMCI.CONTACT_INFO_ID=fpb.CONTACT_INFO_ID WHERE FC.DATA_CLASS = 'NORMAL' AND HBMCI.CONTACT_PERSON is not null AND fpb.bp_role_type in ('SELLER','BUYER') UNION SELECT CC.CONTRACT_ID, PPB.PROJECT_ID, CC.DOCUMENT_CATEGORY, concat(concat(concat(concat(HBMA.country, ( SELECT t1.DESCRIPTION FROM FND_PROVINCE t1 WHERE t1.province = HBMA.province )), ( SELECT t1.DESCRIPTION FROM FND_CITY t1 WHERE t1.city = HBMA.city )), ( SELECT t1.DESCRIPTION FROM FND_DISTRICT t1 WHERE t1.district = HBMA.district)), HBMA.address) AS addressInfo, HBMCI.CONTACT_PERSON AS recipient, HBMCI.CELL_PHONE AS contact_info, '租金' AS description FROM PRJ_PROJECT_BP PPB JOIN CON_CONTRACT CC ON PPB.PROJECT_ID=CC.PROJECT_ID LEFT JOIN hls_bp_master_address HBMA ON HBMA.ADDRESS_ID=PPB.ADDRESS_ID LEFT JOIN hls_bp_master_contact_info HBMCI ON HBMCI.CONTACT_INFO_ID=PPB.CONTACT_INFO_ID WHERE PPB.BP_TYPE='TENANT' ) CON WHERE 1=1 AND CON.CONTRACT_ID=#{contractId} AND CON.DOCUMENT_CATEGORY=#{businessType}
AND CON.recipient like concat('%',concat(#{recipient},'%'))
